Mint $50 of Vault Street's yield asset on Ethereum and hold it unencumbered in the farming wallet. Cost: $50 of capital and about $16 of gas. Time: 20 minutes to set up.

Split the position in two: keep half as placed and move the other half into a second Vault Street pool or market on Ethereum a week later, so the history is not a single day. Cost: about $16 of gas for the second placement. Time: 10 minutes, one week after the first.
Return every week for one rewards check on the protocol's own page, plus a $10 top-up mint monthly. Cost: about $12 of gas a week, $108 across the whole hold. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position at least 60 days without emptying it, so the activity spans more than one of the protocol's own snapshots. Its TVL moved -0.5% this week, inside its normal range. Cost: the $50 stays in the position; the running cost is the weekly gas above. Time: 60 days.

Halfway through the hold, at day 30, re-price the position against this page's model: by then the plan has spent about $74 of its $148 budget for a protocol the model values at $2,005,637 implied. If Vault Street has announced a points program or a token, skip ahead to the claim step; if its TVL has fallen more than 40% since the snapshot, cut the hold short and keep only the minimum position. Cost: no new spend; the review protects the $50 already placed. Time: 15 minutes, once, at the halfway point.

When a token or points claim is announced, claim only from the link on Vault Street's own page or its verified announcement channel, and log every transaction hash in a farm log as you go. Cost: nothing to check the log; never pay anyone to claim for you. Time: 15 minutes at the claim, 5 minutes a week for the log.
